data.message: I propose a 10-ton monthly cap per fisher at stock 500. If all 25 follow it, total catch is 250 and next month's stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome—$10,000 each per month indefinitely. At lower stock, scale catches down to preserve at least half the stock and never leave under 25 tons. I intend to request 10 this month and invite everyone to match.
